(B) Yes, they are very comfortable.
(C) Next to the conference table.

evidence.quote_en: (A) Ms. Patel in the facilities department.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(A) Ms. Patel in the facilities department.」，直接印證正解 (A)「Ms. Patel in the facilities department.」。Who 疑問句詢問授權採購人體工學辦公椅的人員，(A) 回答設施部門的 Patel 女士，直接對應人名與所屬部門；(B) 用 Yes 回應特殊疑問句且語意不合；(C) 回答地點。

difficulty.rationale_zh: What time 時間提問搭配具體航班起飛時刻回應。

audio_script.text_en: What time does our connecting flight to Frankfurt depart?
(A) At Gate C14 in the North Terminal.
(B) At six forty-five this evening.
(C) A window seat in business class.

assets.source_note_zh: 由本機 macOS TTS (/usr/bin/say + afconvert AAC 22.05kHz) 實際合成之單一完整時間軸音檔；角色配音：spk1(Questioner (Male Executive), planned=uk -> voice=Daniel[en_GB])；spk2(Responder (Female Assistant), planned=us -> voice=Samantha[en_US])。

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: At Gate C14 in the North Terminal.
A window seat in business class.

evidence.quote_en: What time does our connecting flight to Frankfurt depart?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「What time does our connecting flight to Frankfurt depart?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。
對應後續關鍵語句「(B) At six forty-five this evening.」，直接印證正解 (B)「At six forty-five this evening.」。What time 詢問飛往法蘭克福的轉機航班起飛時間，(B) 回答今晚六點四十五分，正確提供時間；(A) 回答登機門位置；(C) 回答艙等與座位。

items.explanation_zh: 提問詢問「我們飛往法蘭克福的轉機航班幾點起飛？」，(B)「今晚六點四十五分」直接提供確切起飛時間。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 回答登機門位置（Gate C14），對應 Where 而非 What time。
聯想 flight 而回答商務艙靠窗座位，答非所問。

vocabulary.example_en: Bad weather in Chicago caused several delegates to miss their connecting flight to Munich.

(C) About twenty-seven inches wide.

evidence.quote_en: (A) Please send a replacement to my office.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(A) Please send a replacement to my office.」，直接印證正解 (A)「Please send a replacement to my office.」。選擇疑問句詢問要寄送替換螢幕至辦公室還是選擇商店抵用金，(A) 明確表達請寄送替換品到辦公室；(B) 以 Yes 回應選擇疑問句；(C) 回答螢幕尺寸。

difficulty.rationale_zh: Why 原因提問搭配因為講者行程變動之合理說明。

audio_script.text_en: Why was the keynote speech moved to the morning session?
(A) In the Grand Ballroom on the mezzanine level.
(B) The guest speaker has an afternoon flight to Tokyo.
(C) For about forty-five minutes.

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: In the Grand Ballroom on the mezzanine level.
The guest speaker has an afternoon flight to Tokyo.

evidence.quote_en: Why was the keynote speech moved to the morning session?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「Why was the keynote speech moved to the morning session?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (B) The guest speaker has an afternoon flight to Tokyo.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(B) The guest speaker has an afternoon flight to Tokyo.」，直接印證正解 (B)「The guest speaker has an afternoon flight to Tokyo.」。Why 詢問主題演講改至上午場次的原因，(B) 說明主講嘉賓下午有飛往東京的班機，合理交代改期原因；(A) 回答場地位置；(C) 回答時間長度。

items.explanation_zh: 提問詢問「為什麼主題演講被調到早上的場次？」，(B)「特邀講者下午有一班飛往東京的班機」清楚交代提早場次之原因。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 回答演講廳地點，對應 Where 而非 Why。
回答演講時長，對應 How long 而非 Why。

(A) Actually, two samples showed minor surface corrosion.
(B) No, the laboratory coats are in the locker room.
(C) Every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: Actually, two samples showed minor surface corrosion.

evidence.quote_en: The protective coatings on the turbine blades passed the salt-spray test, didn't they?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「The protective coatings on the turbine blades passed the salt-spray test, didn't they?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (A) Actually, two samples showed minor surface corrosion.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(A) Actually, two samples showed minor surface corrosion.」，直接印證正解 (A)「Actually, two samples showed minor surface corrosion.」。附加問句確認渦輪葉片保護塗層是否通過鹽霧測試，(A) 以「事實上，有兩個樣本出現輕微表面腐蝕」回應測試結果；(B) 以 laboratory coats 混淆 protective coatings；(C) 回答頻率時間。

difficulty.rationale_zh: How 詢問籌措資金方式搭配高階間接回應（董事會仍在評估兩個方案）。

audio_script.text_en: How are we going to fund the expansion of the Montreal distribution center?
(A) About eighty thousand square feet of floor space.
(B) The board is still weighing a bank loan against a bond issue.
(C) Yes, the warehouse manager signed the lease.

items.prompt_en: Listen to the question or statement and three responses. Choose the best response.

choices.text_en: About eighty thousand square feet of floor space.
The board is still weighing a bank loan against a bond issue.

evidence.quote_en: How are we going to fund the expansion of the Montreal distribution center?
evidence.reasoning_zh: 第一處關鍵線索指出「How are we going to fund the expansion of the Montreal distribution center?」，建立題幹核心提問或情境前提。

evidence.quote_en: (B) The board is still weighing a bank loan against a bond issue.
evidence.reasoning_zh: 對應後續關鍵語句「(B) The board is still weighing a bank loan against a bond issue.」，直接印證正解 (B)「The board is still weighing a bank loan against a bond issue.」。How 詢問如何為蒙特婁配送中心擴建案籌措資金，(B) 說明董事會仍在權衡銀行貸款與發行債券兩種籌資方案；(A) 回答樓地板面積；(C) 用 Yes 回應 How 疑問句。

distractor_notes.reason_zh: 聯想 expansion / distribution center 而回答樓地板面積，對應 How large 而非 How to fund。
How 疑問句不可用 Yes 開頭回答。
